title: Use Postgres over MySQL for the billing store
body: Row-level locking behaviour under our reconciliation workload was the deciding factor. MySQL gap locks caused deadlocks in the nightly settlement job.

title: Retry policy is exponential backoff with full jitter
body: Fixed backoff produced synchronised retry storms after a partial outage. Full jitter spread the load.

title: Ship the mobile client as a PWA first
body: Native apps were deferred until we have retention data. Store review latency was the main argument.

title: Adopt trunk-based development
body: Long-lived release branches were accumulating merge debt. Feature flags replace them.

title: Invoices must be immutable once issued
body: Finance and the external auditor both require an append-only correction trail rather than edits in place.

title: All customer data stays in the EU region
body: Contractual with the two largest accounts. Applies to backups and to log aggregation.

title: p99 checkout latency under 400ms
body: Measured at the edge, not at the origin. Regression here blocks a release.

title: Handoff: payment webhook dedupe half-finished
body: The idempotency key is written but the replay window is still hard-coded to one hour. Needs to come from config before this ships.

title: Handoff: staging cluster upgrade
body: Control plane is on the new version, node pools are not. Drain order matters because the logging daemonset is not yet tolerant of the new taint.

title: The nightly export job silently truncates at 10k rows
body: Not a bug in our code; the upstream API paginates and we never followed the cursor. Surfaced during the quarter-end close.

title: Timezone handling in the scheduler is UTC everywhere except the digest email
body: The digest renders in the recipient's local zone, which is why its tests look inconsistent with the rest.

title: Flaky test in the search suite is a port collision
body: Two suites bound the same fixed port. It is not a race in the code under test.

title: Do we need a separate read replica for analytics?
body: Open. Depends on whether the reporting queries stay under the current lock budget.

title: Should webhook retries count against the customer rate limit?
body: Open. Leaning no, but it changes the fairness story for noisy tenants.

title: Dentist appointment moved to the 14th
body: Rescheduled from the 7th.

title: Sourdough starter feeding schedule
body: 1:1:1 by weight, twice a day when it lives on the counter, once a week in the fridge.

title: Espresso grind settings for the new burr set
body: Two clicks finer than the old one for the same dose and yield.

title: Car tyre pressure
body: 2.4 bar front, 2.2 rear when cold.

title: Bike service due at 3000km
body: Chain and cassette were already worn at the last check.

title: Recycling collection is fortnightly on Tuesdays
body: Glass goes to the bring bank, not the kerbside bin.
